tagline.en: Most of the Lincoln Highway, and the first paved road across
tagline.zh: 林肯公路的主体，也是首条全程铺装的横贯公路

start.zh: 俄勒冈州阿斯托里亚，与 US 101 相接

en: US 30 is the numbered descendant of the Lincoln Highway, and for most of its length it is the old road that runs beside a railway. From Atlantic City it crosses New Jersey to Camden, then takes the Lancaster Pike west through Pennsylvania Dutch country, over the Alleghenies by way of Gettysburg and Bedford, and into Pittsburgh. Ohio and Indiana are flat going through Canton, Fort Wayne and Valparaiso; Illinois and Iowa the same, with Joliet, Cedar Rapids and Ames on the line.

Nebraska is where the road is most itself. For some four hundred and fifty miles it follows the Platte River and the Union Pacific main line — Fremont, Columbus, Grand Island, Kearney, North Platte, Ogallala — the same corridor as the Oregon Trail and, since 1974, I-80. Beyond Cheyenne it climbs the Laramie plains and runs across southern Wyoming to Granger, where the Lincoln Highway went on to Salt Lake and US 30 does not. It turns northwest instead through Idaho and eastern Oregon, joins the Columbia at Pendleton, and reaches the sea at Astoria.
zh: US 30 是林肯公路在编号系统中的后裔，其大部分路段都是紧挨铁路的那条老路。它自大西洋城横穿新泽西至卡姆登，再沿兰开斯特收费道西行，穿过宾夕法尼亚荷兰人乡间，经葛底斯堡与贝德福德翻越阿勒格尼山，进入匹兹堡。俄亥俄与印第安纳一路平坦，途经坎顿、韦恩堡与瓦尔帕莱索；伊利诺伊与艾奥瓦亦然，线上有乔利埃特、锡达拉皮兹与艾姆斯。

内布拉斯加是这条路最像它自己的地方。约四百五十英里的路程里，它沿普拉特河与联合太平洋铁路干线而行——弗里蒙特、哥伦布、大岛、卡尼、北普拉特、奥加拉拉——与俄勒冈小道同一条走廊，1974 年以后也与 I-80 同走廊。过夏延后，它爬上拉勒米平原，横穿怀俄明州南部至格兰杰；林肯公路由此继续前往盐湖城，US 30 却不。它转向西北，穿过爱达荷与俄勒冈东部，在彭德尔顿与哥伦比亚河会合，最终在阿斯托里亚入海。

en: In 1920 the Lincoln Highway Association decided to build a demonstration piece — a stretch of road designed not for the traffic of the day but for what was expected two decades out. Seventeen of the country's leading highway engineers met over the winter of 1920–21 and settled the specification: a 110-foot right of way, forty feet of concrete ten inches thick, no curve tighter than a thousand-foot radius, curves banked for 35 mph, no grade crossings, no advertising signs, and a separate footpath for pedestrians.

The Ideal Section was built between Dyer and Schererville, Indiana, during 1922 and 1923, paid for out of federal-aid, state and county funds plus $130,000 from the United States Rubber Company, whose president was one of the association's founders. Engineers came from around the world to look at it. Thirteen years later the last unpaved link in the whole Atlantic City-to-Astoria route — thirty miles near North Platte, Nebraska — opened on 5 November 1935, making US 30 the first paved road across the continent.
zh: 1920 年，林肯公路协会决定修建一段示范路——其设计标准不针对当时的交通，而是着眼二十年后的预期需求。全国 17 位顶尖公路工程师在 1920 至 1921 年冬季开会敲定了规格：110 英尺路权带、40 英尺宽、10 英寸厚的混凝土路面，曲线半径不小于 1,000 英尺，弯道按每小时 35 英里超高，不设平交道口，不设广告标牌，并另设行人步道。
这段「理想路段」于 1922 至 1923 年间建于印第安纳州代尔与谢雷维尔之间，资金来自联邦补助、州与县款项，外加美国橡胶公司捐助的 13 万美元——该公司总裁正是协会创始人之一。各国工程师专程前来考察。十三年后，自大西洋城至阿斯托里亚全线最后一段未铺装路——内布拉斯加州北普拉特附近的三十英里——于 1935 年 11 月 5 日通车，US 30 由此成为首条全程铺装的横贯大陆公路。

en: The Lincoln Highway Association was incorporated in Detroit on 1 July 1913 with Henry Joy as its first president, and set out to build a marked, toll-free road from New York to San Francisco. When the numbering plan broke up the named trails, nearly two-thirds of the Lincoln became US 30; the rest went to US 1 east of Philadelphia, US 530, US 40 over Donner Pass and US 50 across Nevada.

US 30's western half is an accident of negotiation. The Joint Board's 1925 draft ended US 30 at Salt Lake City and carried US 20 through Yellowstone and Pocatello to Portland. Oregon, Idaho, Wyoming and Utah met, decided the practical way to the Northwest was across southern Wyoming, and had the numbers exchanged. US 30 was carried on to Astoria and US 20 was stopped at Yellowstone. That is why US 30 leaves the Lincoln Highway at Granger.

The association wound up its work at the end of 1927 and marked the road one last time. On 1 September 1928 Boy Scouts placed concrete posts along the route, each bearing a small bust of Lincoln — roughly one per mile, at positions surveyed in advance by the association's field secretary. Many are still standing. Interstate 80 took the through traffic from Nebraska in 1974, but US 30 remains one of the state's main highways.
zh: 林肯公路协会于 1913 年 7 月 1 日在底特律注册成立，首任会长为亨利·乔伊，宗旨是修建一条有标识、不收费、自纽约通往旧金山的道路。编号方案拆散各条命名汽车道时，林肯公路近三分之二成为 US 30；其余分别划归费城以东的 US 1、US 530、翻越唐纳山口的 US 40 以及横穿内华达的 US 50。
US 30 的西半段出自一场谈判的偶然。联合委员会 1925 年的草案让 US 30 止于盐湖城，而由 US 20 经黄石与波卡特洛通往波特兰。俄勒冈、爱达荷、怀俄明与犹他四州会商后认定，通往西北部的可行通道是怀俄明州南部，于是两个编号对调：US 30 继续延伸至阿斯托里亚，US 20 则止于黄石。这也是 US 30 在格兰杰离开林肯公路的原因。
协会于 1927 年底结束工作，并最后一次为这条路做了标记。1928 年 9 月 1 日，童子军沿线埋设混凝土标桩，每根上都有一尊林肯小胸像——大致每英里一根，位置由协会外勤秘书事先勘定。其中许多至今仍在。1974 年 I-80 带走了内布拉斯加境内的过境车流，但 US 30 仍是该州的主要公路之一。

value.en: $130,000 contributed by the United States Rubber Company towards a 1.3-mile model section at Dyer, Indiana, built 1922–23 with federal-aid, state and county funds
value.zh: 美国橡胶公司为印第安纳州代尔的 1.3 英里示范路段捐助 13 万美元；该路段于 1922 至 1923 年间建成，其余资金来自联邦补助、州与县款项

figures.source: Federal Highway Administration, "The Lincoln Highway," by Richard F. Weingroff

why.en: No figure exists. The Lincoln Highway Association raised private money for demonstration sections but never built the road; US 30 was assembled from state highways in 1926 and has been rebuilt piecemeal by thirteen states since.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。林肯公路协会曾为示范路段筹集私人资金，但并未修建整条道路；US 30 于 1926 年由各州公路拼合而成，此后由 13 个州分段陆续改建。

why.en: There is no current authoritative figure. AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and last published a national log in 1989; US 30 has been realigned repeatedly since, particularly in Pennsylvania, Iowa and Oregon.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数据。AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，最后一份全国里程表发布于 1989 年；此后 US 30 多次改线，尤以宾夕法尼亚、艾奥瓦与俄勒冈三州为甚。

why.en: Thirteen state agencies count their own segments, and nothing joins them up. US 30 is an urban arterial east of Pittsburgh and in the Chicago suburbs and a rural two-lane road across much of Wyoming and Idaho.
why.zh: 13 个州的机构各自统计本州路段，彼此并不汇总。US 30 在匹兹堡以东与芝加哥郊区是城市干道，在怀俄明与爱达荷的大部分路段则是乡村双车道公路。

label.zh: 首条全程铺装的横贯大陆路线

value.en: The final unpaved link, a 30-mile section near North Platte, Nebraska, opened on 5 November 1935; President Roosevelt sent a telegram to be read at the ceremony
value.zh: 最后一段未铺装路——内布拉斯加州北普拉特附近的 30 英里——于 1935 年 11 月 5 日通车；罗斯福总统致电，在通车典礼上宣读

conditionFigures.source: Federal Highway Administration, "Ask the Rambler: Was the Lincoln Highway the First Transcontinental Highway?"

value.en: About 3,000 concrete posts were cast and 2,436 were actually placed, by Boy Scout troops beginning at 9 a.m. on 1 September 1928; each weighs over 220 pounds
value.zh: 共浇筑约 3,000 根混凝土标桩，实际埋设 2,436 根；1928 年 9 月 1 日上午 9 时起由童子军各团埋设，每根重逾 220 磅

conditionFigures.source: Lincoln Highway Association, "Those Marvelous Memorial Markers"

timeline.en: The Lincoln Highway Association is incorporated in Detroit on 1 July, with Henry Joy as president.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，林肯公路协会在底特律注册成立，亨利·乔伊任会长。

timeline.en: The Ideal Section, a model stretch of road in Lake County, Indiana, is completed.
timeline.zh: 位于印第安纳州莱克县的示范路段「理想路段」建成。

timeline.en: US 30 is approved on 11 November, from Atlantic City, New Jersey, to Astoria, Oregon.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 30 获批，自新泽西州大西洋城至俄勒冈州阿斯托里亚。

timeline.en: Boy Scouts place the Lincoln Highway's concrete memorial markers along the route on 1 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 1 日，童子军沿线埋设林肯公路混凝土纪念标桩。

timeline.en: The last unpaved link near North Platte, Nebraska, opens on 5 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 5 日，内布拉斯加州北普拉特附近最后一段未铺装路通车。

timeline.en: I-80 is completed across Nebraska and takes the through traffic off US 30.
timeline.zh: I-80 在内布拉斯加州全线建成，把过境车流从 US 30 上带走。
